subject: lavPredict error for growth curve model

messages.author: 19db333399a1b397
messages.subject: lavPredict error for growth curve model
parts:
Hello everyone,

I've used lavPredict before with no issues, but I've been having trouble getting the LV scores out of a hierarchical growth curve model.

Whenever I run lavPredict on this type of model, I get this error:
Error in `[<-`(`*tmp*`, , ov.x.dummy.lv.idx, value = eXo) :
  subscript out of bounds
In addition: Warning message:
In lav_object_post_check(object) :
  lavaan WARNING: some estimated lv variances are negative

(The variances it is talking about aren't very negative, they are constrained to be above 0. This has been fine for fitting the model, though in the summary a couple of the variances still display as being -0.000)

I saw that someone else had come across this issue ( https://stackoverflow.com/questions/38469896/extracting-individual-trajectories-in-lavaan-growth-curve-models ), and saw that missing data might be to blame. I've tried this with stable lavaan (0.5-23) and the current development version from github, which I think might be better able to handle missing values? The error has been the same, regardless. I also tried giving lavPredict newdata with just the complete.cases, but that didn't change anything, either. I'm using R 3.4.3, as well.

Has anyone had any luck resolving this error under these conditions? (Thanks!)
